svg.text: orange: held by a transaction waiting on HTTP
transactions open, call the payments API, and commit in 50 ms. A connection is idle in transaction for a moment, then free
the payments API slows down. A request opens a transaction, calls it, and holds its server connection while it waits
no free connection, so the pool opens a few more. Each request calls the API inside its transaction, and holds one
every server connection is held by a transaction waiting on HTTP. The pool is exhausted and the database is idle
the payments API recovers. Every connection is still held and every app instance is still stuck
